aggregate_defects.symptom: The model authored material numbers in three value-and-profit Numeric Fact statements and one explanation even though exact request-local aliases were selected and local rendering was mandatory.
aggregate_defects.project_design_contribution: The model still owns arbitrary narrative fields adjacent to high-stakes alias selection.

aggregate_defects.symptom: The bottleneck Cell authored one unbound calendar year, one inventory measurement under Evidence support, one percentage Numeric Fact narrative, and two free-text percentage thresholds.
aggregate_defects.project_design_contribution: Temporal aliases close dates, but free threshold text and Evidence statements still permit material numeric leakage.

aggregate_defects.symptom: The value-and-profit claim stage returned six candidates against a one-to-two contract. Stable truncation selected a mixed-scope Fact and caused local scope ambiguity; a locally assemblable existing subset was required.
aggregate_defects.project_design_contribution: The model was asked to both generate and obey final delivery cardinality, while the runtime lacked a validity-aware selector.

aggregate_defects.symptom: Exact local numeric expansion produced three Fact statements longer than the legacy 320-character Provider narrative limit; the longest was 490 characters.
The pre-call cost estimator priced UTF-8 bytes as if each byte were one input token and blocked the Verifier even though actual cumulative cost remained inside the USD 0.10 hard cap.

The machine Verifier returned four passes and accept_for_internal_review although the report retained mechanical English numeric clauses, treated complementary evidence gaps as conflicts, and repeated an inventory-data absence claim beside exact company inventory data.

root_cause_clusters.cause: Prompt prohibitions are being used where the runtime should own material numbers, thresholds, dates and final narrative rendering.
root_cause_clusters.structural_fix: Reduce Provider output to request-local aliases and finite judgment atoms; render material truth locally.

root_cause_clusters.cause: One model response is expected to generate alternatives, rank them, satisfy exact cardinality and remain locally scope-assemblable.
root_cause_clusters.structural_fix: Accept bounded candidate atoms and perform deterministic validity-aware selection and ordering.

root_cause_clusters.cause: Prompt, schema, local renderer, text capacity and budget estimator are versioned separately without compile-time cross-invariants.
root_cause_clusters.structural_fix: Generate surfaces from one typed contract and add worst-case render-size and unit-consistent budget invariants.

root_cause_clusters.cause: The current Verifier is strong on shape, lineage, identity and numeric correspondence but weak on conflict semantics, decision usefulness and delivery quality.
root_cause_clusters.structural_fix: Keep L1 deterministic and calibrate L2-L4 with cached-output rubrics, paired baselines and owner review in T08-T10/S5.
